name: 2b2t
description:
2B2TBE is a Cross Platform Server built upon an Anarchy Society where players can expect absolute freedom.

This will be a great alternative to 2b2t as you can freely play this on virtually any platform that has Minecraft even Switch & Java!

Upon entering this server, you soon realize how chaotic a world can be where there is no “higher power”, the whole game is based around the players that play it, many will come and leave. While others will stay to make history… 

Server launched: July 1st, 2019

Map size: 3+ TB
